prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Full bleed adoption certificate preview redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a full bleed layout featuring an interactive pet certificate preview with official adoption stamp animation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "full_bleed", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:cert_preview", "style": "large", "action": "play"}]}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality quiz screen before friend pick: Insert a new interactive quiz screen before friend selection to recommend the best matching pet type based on user preferences.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_pet_quiz", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_quiz": {"headline": "Find Your Ideal Desktop Pet", "body": "Answer two quick questions to discover which pet personality matches your desktop style.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select your play style", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet accessories customization screen: Add a new screen after pet friend selection where users pick initial starter accessories for their pet before completing adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_accessories", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_accessories": {"headline": "Style Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Pick starting accessories to personalize your companion.", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose starter items", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom pet photo validation preview flow: Replace photo upload components with a multi-stage upload flow that validates image quality and shows a real-time pet rendering preview.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"replace": {"photo_upload": [{"role": "photo_upload", "type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload Photo", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}, {"role": "photo_upload", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:photo_preview", "style": "rounded", "action": "play"}]}}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Stage layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign the choose path screen into a stage layout with animated path showcases highlighting quick preset versus custom paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage"}}
5: [home, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for waiting screen: Redesign the loading waiting screen into a full bleed progress dashboard featuring dynamic asset loading animations.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "full_bleed"}}
6: [sign_in, layout] Compact layout redesign for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout with streamlined single-click authentication options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact"}}
7: [finish, layout] Split layout redesign for home intro screen: Reorganize the final home intro screen into a split layout separating pet welcome visuals from desktop controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split"}}
8: [adoption, hint] Custom photo guideline hint on photo upload screen: Display a helpful hint detailing lighting and photo framing best practices on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload a clear front-facing photo with good lighting and a single subject."}}
9: [finish, hint] Desktop pet visibility hint on home intro screen: Add an explicit status hint on the home intro screen explaining how to locate and summon the pet via the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "If your pet does not appear on screen immediately, click the pet icon in your system tray to summon it."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign keeps the required adoption certificate functionality and official stamp intact within onboarding.
Adding a personality quiz screen within onboarding order is allowed and retains all required steps.
Adding an accessories customization screen during onboarding is allowed and mentions no pricing or free gifts.
Redesigning the photo upload flow with real-time preview retains the photo upload step and job.
Redesigning choose path layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the sign in screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding photo upload guidelines hint inside onboarding is allowed and fair.
Adding a system tray hint on home intro inside onboarding is allowed.
